remarks: Darien, CT | For Lease  What a show-stopper of a rental! This totally renovated and expanded Cape Cod is ideally located in Darien on the New Canaan / Springdale-Stamford border, offering both charm and modern convenience.  From the moment you enter, you're welcomed by a foyer with coat closet leading into a spacious living room featuring new recessed lighting. The heart of the home is the brand-new expanded kitchen, complete with high-end finishes and modern amenities, flowing seamlessly into the dining room with vaulted ceiling and sliders opening to a spacious, level backyard-perfect for everyday living and entertaining. Landlord pays for landscaping!! The main level features two bedrooms and a tastefully updated full bath. Upstairs, enjoy a versatile space ideal for a home office, leading to the expanded primary suite with a new full bath, fabulous walk-in closet, and bedroom filled with oversized windows.  The laundry is located on the lower level, and there's a cedar closet. Bonus space - come check it out! A detached garage provides excellent storage for seasonal items.  Walk to stores, post office, CVS, eateries, and the Springdale train station. Truly a gem - this is what you've been waiting for!
